svg.aria-label: The blade buffer holds both levels: LOD 0, 15 vertices each, in slots 0 up to capacity0, and LOD 1, 7 vertices each, in slots capacity0 up to capacity0 + capacity1. Draw 0 starts at firstInstance 0 and draw 1 at firstInstance capacity0.
